verdicts.why: Seed 'how you're going to pay' renders पैसे only inside the verb 'pay'; the row is about this sentence and its LEGO.
Seed 'you're going to pay for a new bed' has no 'money'; पैसे is glossed literally and belongs to L1.
अशी is in LEGO L3 (myself having) but the seed 'myself having exactly the same problem' does not render 'that'.
असेल is in L3 glossed 'would have' while the seed has 'having'; a literal gloss, not a stray.
हे is in L2 हे बघायला (to check), but the seed 'To check if you've been able to finish' does not render 'this'.
हे is in L2 but the seed 'why we needed to stay here' / 'you'll forget' has no 'this'.

Target 'a good thing [is_new=false]' carries a stray annotation; the real text 'a good thing' is in the seed, but the correct value is a judgement call and the row duplicates L2, so it is not a proven cut.
आणेपर्यंत is in L2 (while I fetch); the seed 'while I fetch the keys' has 'while' where the row says 'until'.
इतका is in L2 नवीन आणण्याइतका; the seed 'too tired to fetch a new one' has no 'enough'.
बनवणे/'to make' is the lemma form of बनवणारी / 'makes' in the seed, which is L3.
काही is in L3 काही वर्षांपूर्वी (years ago); the seed's 'years ago' has no 'a few'.
तो is in L1 तो प्रत्येक शब्द; the seed 'every word you say' has no 'that'.
खात्री/'certainty' glosses a word inside L1 'I'm not convinced'; it is a related form, not a seed substring.
सांगणे/'to tell' is the lemma of सांगितलं ('told') in the seed, which is L1.
पलीकडे is in L2 गवतावरून पलीकडे (across the grass); 'across' is rendered once and 'over' is a literal gloss.
अगदी is in L2 अगदी योग्य घर (the perfect house); the seed 'the perfect house' has no 'just'.
खूप is in L1 मी खूप थकलोय; the seed renders it as 'too tired', not 'very'.
तो is in L4 तो अगदी बरोबर होता; the seed 'Whoever said it would be difficult was absolutely right' has no 'he'.
अजून is in L3 अजून पुढे (any longer); the seed has 'any longer', and 'any more' differs, so the correct value is not forced to one reading.
देणार/'going to give' glosses a word the seed renders as 'going to pay'; same LEGO, so not a stray.
